title: Experiments: my experiments, ordered and ticked
intro: Experiments are added to a list in the order of preference. Each has its own name, design and largest number of runs; only the ticked ones are run, from the top down, or saved together in one folder.

marks.d: Ticks the experiments that are run or saved.
The name of the experiment; it becomes the name of its folder.
The design of this experiment on its own.
The largest number of runs of this experiment.
Moves the experiment earlier in the list.
Runs the ticked experiments one after another.
Saves the ticked experiments as E1, E2 and so on in one zip.
Saves the ticked plans as one JSON file.
